To right her wrong, she is forced to team up with a neurotic but sensitive, truth-telling monster. The unlikely duo sets off on a mind-blowing journey to save the very traditions Angelina wanted to leave behind. A modern coming-of-age adventure, Twisted explores the universal themes of soul-searching. It challenges our relationship with truth, lies and looks at how life-changing decisions can sometimes affect the people we love.
